boundary: Root alone provisions, journals, runs and cleans shared pair. This is a fixture request, not SQL execution or a passing receipt.

fields.dictionaryUpdateId: root-owned active lead-source UUID, name E Original, description old, sortOrder 100, updatedBy actorId
fields.dictionaryNoopId: root-owned active lead-source UUID, name E Noop, updatedBy actorId

setting.requestId: root-journalled <=55 character request ID, plus pre-journalled -noop suffix
setting.snapshotId: root journal exact original row or absence

dictionaryRows.usage: Two real domain rows per source code: include a historical/inactive/deleted or voided state where the actual source table supports it; DictionaryRepository counts all states. No view/stub/new relation.

relations.attachment-category: poms.attachment.category; own version_group_id, distinct storage_key/checksum, non-sensitive synthetic metadata; no upload/filesystem action
relations.sales-follow-up-type: poms.sales_follow_up_record.follow_up_type; use owned customer/project/actor/org references and valid actual status/outcome
relations.expense-category: poms.expense_record.expense_category; owned project_id; original valid status/source_type and small synthetic decimal amount
relations.lead-source: poms.lead.source_code; owned customer/owner references and original valid required fields

dictionaryRows.sortAndSearch: At least 3 same-domain items with differing sortOrder/code and one nullable description; include mixed code/name/description keyword hits, % and _ wildcard probes. Unique domain/code and IDs pre-journalled.
dictionaryRows.writeDefaults: POST create's domain/code intent is journalled before HTTP; success ID is adopted by exact code/domain/actor. Include a row with is_system=true to show no extra edit ban.
dictionaryRows.errors: Reserve missing ID; duplicate code; dirty and no-op rows; stale expectedVersion; optional oversized int4 sortOrder accepted by DTO then rejected by PG. No physical delete route.

settings.restore: Snapshot exact registered row including presence/value_json/value_type/row_version/created_at/updated_at/updated_by before first mutation; restore exact bytes/absence after all runs.
cases: registered list and unknown stored key excluded
same actor/value has no setting UPDATE but records audit
independent audit failure leaves preceding setting business commit
settings.auditAdoption: Pre-journal targetType=SystemSetting,targetId=registeredKey,actorId,unique requestId; adopt newly generated audit IDs by exact ownership. Reject unknown observed rows.

numbers.noSeedPeriods: Use only root-reserved year rows; never consume ambient 2026 sequences. Register scope/period intent before absent-row creation.
cases: all nine source scopes and descriptions
UTC cross-year independently of PG timezone
borrowed connection outer BEGIN/ROLLBACK and forced caller failure rollback
default independent connection commit survives caller rollback
int4 overflow remains original database failure
numbers.concurrency: numberConcurrency period differs from all borrowed/standalone cases; root pre-journals its row and expected allocation span before test. Test must not clean or broaden ownership.

nestSqlWitness: dictionary create: INSERT + pending AuthSession CAS ordering and rollback
dictionary dirty/no-op update: session CAS versus dictionary CAS, changed columns, rowVersion/updatedAt
setting absent/create, dirty and no-op: first business flush versus second awaited audit flush
stale managed session/business CAS; raw touch remains separately committed
forced audit storage failure after completed setting flush
business number default connection and borrowed transaction rollback/concurrency
